# gbautomation.xyz agent surfaces

Public read-only surfaces for agents:

- GBauto style JSON: https://gbautoxyz.netlify.app/tac/style.json
- GBauto style markdown: https://gbautoxyz.netlify.app/tac/style.md
- Agent style instructions: https://gbautoxyz.netlify.app/tac/agent-style.md
- Style primitives CSS: https://gbautoxyz.netlify.app/tac/style-primitives.css
- Public assets JSON: https://gbautoxyz.netlify.app/tac/assets.json
- Public assets markdown: https://gbautoxyz.netlify.app/tac/assets.md
- TAC catalog JSON: https://gbautoxyz.netlify.app/tac/catalog.json
- TAC catalog UI: https://gbautoxyz.netlify.app/tac

Rules:

- Public surfaces are read-only and cacheable.
- Do not expect public endpoints to dispatch agents or expose private TAC inventory.
- For GB-branded frontend work, use `get-gbauto-theme` and the style packet above.
- Private TAC execution, client records, and internal second-brain paths require an authenticated/private surface.
